page_title: BRE 2-0 HAV | Brest v Le Havre 06/10/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+5' The referee blows his whistle, Le Havre are awarded a corner kick.
90+2' 2 - 0 Goal! Ibrahim Salah (Brest) collects a pass and without hesitation fires an unstoppable shot into the roof of the net.
90+2' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Le Havre, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
88' Didier Digard has decided to make a change. Samuel Grandsir (Le Havre) replaces Loic Nego.
87' OFF THE WOODWORK! Ibrahim Salah (Brest) picks up the ball inside the box and produces a snap shot that smashes against the crossbar!
84' Emmanuel Sabbi (Le Havre) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle.
82' The substitution is prepared. Antoine Joujou (Le Havre) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Abdoulaye Toure.
81' Benoit Millot interrupts the game. One of the players from Le Havre won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
79' Pierre Lees-Melou (Brest) was probably a bit loose with his words to Benoit Millot, who decides to show him a yellow.
76' Brest hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
73' Benoit Millot blows his whistle and Massadio Haidara (Brest) is shown a second yellow card for his foul. His manager will not be pleased. He has lot of time to think about it as he walks off.
72' Now Le Havre have a corner.
69' Eric Roy has decided to substitute Mahdi Camara and he is replaced by Jonas Martin (Brest).
69' A substitution has been made. Kamory Doumbia goes off and Romain Del Castillo (Brest) comes on.
67' It's a throw-in for Brest.
64' Here is a change. Oussama Targhalline is going off and Didier Digard gives the last tactical orders to Daler Kuzyaev (Le Havre).
64' Didier Digard prepares a substitution. Ilyes Housni is replaced by Yassine Kechta (Le Havre).
63' A substitution has been made. Rassoul Ndiaye is replaced by Emmanuel Sabbi (Le Havre).
63' The ball goes out of play and Brest will have a goal kick.
59' The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Le Havre.
57' Eric Roy decides to make a substitution. Abdoulaye Ndiaye will be replaced by Soumaila Coulibaly (Brest).
57' Substitution. Ibrahim Salah (Brest) has come on for Mama Balde.
56' Pierre Lees-Melou (Brest) commits a rough challenge and Benoit Millot blows his whistle for an infringement. Le Havre have a free kick from a promising distance.
54' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 3:11.
53' The ball goes out of play. Le Havre are awarded a corner kick.
52' Mathias Pereira Lage (Brest) aims a low effort to the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save.
50' The ball goes out of play. Le Havre are awarded a corner kick.
48' Etienne Youte Kinkoue (Le Havre) receives a red card after his awful challenge. He completely lost his temper and referee Benoit Millot sends him off the pitch.
46' Eric Roy makes a switch. Pierre Lees-Melou (Brest) is coming on in place of Mathias Pereira Lage at the start of the second period.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+2' Le Havre will take a corner kick.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
42' Issa Soumare (Le Havre) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.

39' Abdoulaye Toure (Le Havre) wins the ball from the corner kick and strikes. The effort lacks accuracy and goes miles wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Brest will have a goal kick.
39' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Le Havre will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
38' The referee blows his whistle as Mahdi Camara (Brest) was too aggressive in his challenge.
36' Mama Balde (Brest) is penalised for a foul. Benoit Millot had a clear view and blows his whistle. Le Havre are awarded the free kick.
35' The shots on goal statistics – 1:0.
33' Rassoul Ndiaye (Le Havre) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but the ball is blocked by one of his teammates.
31' Kamory Doumbia (Brest) brings his opponent down. Benoit Millot has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick is awarded to Le Havre.
29' The ball is out of play. Le Havre will have a chance to score from a corner.
29' The referee signals a corner kick to Le Havre.
28' Etienne Youte Kinkoue (Le Havre) receives the ball inside the box from the resulting free kick, but fails to score as his shot is blocked by one of the defenders.
28' The ref seems satisfied following his VAR review and the yellow card for Abdoulaye Ndiaye (Brest) stands. Play continues.

26' There's a break in play and the referee must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier infringement by Abdoulaye Ndiaye (Brest) using VAR. This could result in a red card!
25' Benoit Millot shows a yellow card to Abdoulaye Ndiaye (Brest), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
23' Christopher Operi (Le Havre) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat. The ball is behind the touchline and Le Havre will take a throw-in.
20' Kenny Lala (Brest) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players. The ball goes out of play and Le Havre will have a goal kick.
19' A long-range free kick is awarded to Brest.
17' Massadio Haidara (Brest) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Benoit Millot ignores the protests.
15' Some great controlled play and passing from Le Havre. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
12' 1 - 0 Ludovic Ajorque (Brest) meets a perfect cross from Mama Balde deep inside the box, and he produces an accurate strike which goes into the bottom right corner. He makes it 1:0.
11' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Brest, is intercepted by one of the defenders. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Le Havre.
10' Brest get a corner.
7' One of the players from Brest times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
6' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Le Havre comes to nothing.
5' Christopher Operi (Le Havre) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
3' The ball has crossed the sideline. Brest are taking a throw-in.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Le Havre will have the kick-off.
Benoit Millot is the one to supervise the game today.
